test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The little boy demanded colourful balloons, ribbons in the village fair. When the father didn't pay heed to his demands, the boy made a _____ .
solution: The correct answer is** wry face**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Wry face: **a disdainful grimace; show disappointment by frowning. (नाक-भौं सिकोड़कर निराशा दिखाना) • ***Example: **She pulled a **wry face **when I asked her how it had gone.* • The sentence implies that the boy made a frowning face when his father refused to pay heed to his demands. • **Pay heed to** means **to pay attention to.** • Example: He failed to** pay heed to **our advice. • Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Cloven hoof: **the evil intention. (दुष्ट इरादा) • **A far cry: **to be completely different from something. (किसी चीज से बिल्कुल अलग होना) • **Jaundiced eye:** to look upon something with prejudice, usually in a cynical or negative way. (किसी चीज को पूर्वाग्रह से देखने के लिए, आमतौर पर एक निंदक या नकारात्मक तरीके से) 38:T91c, The correct answer is **link**.
